rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that makes people feel awkward or self-conscious.

example.english: It was really embarrassing when he called my name wrong in front of so many people.
example.traditional: 佢喺咁多人面前叫錯我個名，真係好尷尬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 giu3 co3 ngo5 go3 meng2 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Choose this when the embarrassing thing makes someone lose face or look bad socially.

example.english: Yelling at someone like that in front of everyone at work is really embarrassing.
example.traditional: 喺公司大庭廣眾咁樣鬧人，真係好丟架。
example.jyutping: hai2 gung1 si1 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 gam2 joeng6 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa3

rows.note: Choose this when the embarrassment comes from behavior that is rude, improper, or disrespectful.

example.english: Being late when meeting someone for the first time is really embarrassing.
example.traditional: 第一次見人就遲到，真係好失禮。
example.jyutping: dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 jan4 zau6 ci4 dou3 zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5

rows.note: Choose this for something cringeworthy, tacky, or painful to watch rather than merely awkward.

example.english: The way he sang on stage was so embarrassing I couldn't watch.
example.traditional: 佢喺台上唱到咁，真係肉酸到我睇唔落去。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 coeng3 dou3 gam2 zan1 hai6 juk6 syun1 dou3 ngo5 tai2 m4 lok6 heoi3
